title: NJ TRANSIT interagency after-action report: FIFA World Cup operations
extraction: Manually transcribed eight match columns from the Ridership & Service Data table; egress passenger and duration rows only. Checked against the published table.
limits: Agency-reported aggregates have not been independently audited.
Mode counts and American Dream pedestrian counts are not a disjoint accounting of all spectators; do not sum pedestrian and mode counts.
The report includes negative unallocated totals and estimated categories; those categories are excluded from this model.
Egress duration is a system clearance window, not an individual passenger's waiting time.
This is a retrospective 2026 case and future-event scenario tool, not a pre-tournament forecast.
